subject: flower
title: Three Sunflowers in Terracotta Pot
summary: A potted sunflower arrangement with three open yellow sunflower heads on green stems above broad leafy foliage, set in a terracotta-coloured pot with a matching saucer.
observations: Three clearly visible open sunflower blooms face forward.
The centre bloom is tallest and slightly larger; left and right blooms sit lower, forming a wide triangular arrangement.
Blooms have bright yellow ray petals with large dark brown to black central discs.
Foliage is dense with broad, heart-shaped green leaves and visible green stems.
Container is a tapered terracotta pot with a raised rim and matching round saucer; dark soil is visible at the top.
uncertainties: No exact scale reference is present, so dimensions are estimated from a typical medium potted sunflower arrangement.
Back side and full depth of foliage are not visible; rear bloom or leaf detail should remain simple and conservative.
Central discs appear nearly black in the middle with dark brown outer texture; a single dark-brown centre colour is used for the model.

palette.region: very dark centre shading and visible pot

viewNotes: Front view should show three sunflower heads in a triangular layout: tallest and largest in the centre, smaller heads to left and right slightly lower, all facing forward. A tapered terracotta pot with saucer anchors the dense green leaves, with long stems rising through the foliage.
